name: Wave Accounting
description: Query Wave Accounting (businesses, customers, products, invoices, chart of accounts) and create customers or email invoices via Wave's GraphQL API from any AI agent. 8 tools, Bearer token auth.
instructions:
This connector wraps the Wave GraphQL API (gql.waveapps.com/graphql/public).

**Setup**:
1. Sign in to https://my.waveapps.com → bottom-left avatar → **Manage Applications → Create Application**.
2. Use the OAuth flow to obtain an access token, OR (faster) generate a **Full Access Token** from the application settings (single-tenant).
3. **Business ID**: Wave is multi-business — call `wave_get_businesses` and take the `id` of the business to work in.
4. Set `WAVE_ACCESS_TOKEN` and `WAVE_BUSINESS_ID`.

**Authentication**: `Authorization: Bearer ${WAVE_ACCESS_TOKEN}`.

**Every business-level tool takes `business_id`** (customers, products, invoices, accounts, and reading one invoice): Wave reaches all of them through `business(id: …)`. Pass the ID from `wave_get_businesses` on each call.

**GraphQL-only**: Wave has no REST. The auto-injected GraphQL builtins (`wave_accounting_graphql_query`, `wave_accounting_graphql_mutation`, `wave_accounting_graphql_schema`) are available for arbitrary queries. The typed wrappers below cover the most common cases.

**Pagination is by page, not cursor**: list tools take `page` (1-based) and `page_size` (Wave's default is 45), and answer with `pageInfo { currentPage totalPages totalCount }`. Ask for the next page while `currentPage < totalPages`.

**Money** is a `{ value, currency }` object: `value` is a decimal string in major units ("12.50"), `minorUnitValue` the same amount in cents.

**Mutations** answer with `didSucceed` and `inputErrors { path message }` rather than an HTTP error: `didSucceed: false` means Wave refused the change — read `inputErrors`.

**Rate limits**: 60 req/min per token + complexity budget. 429 with `Retry-After`.

**Out of scope here**: payroll, payment-processing setup, bank-feed reconciliation UI.

tools.name: wave_get_businesses
tools.description: List the businesses the token can access (id, name, currency, whether it is a personal business). Start here: every other tool needs a business ID from this result.

endpointMapping.path: query Businesses { businesses(page: 1, pageSize: 50) { pageInfo { currentPage totalPages totalCount } edges { node { id name isPersonal isArchived currency { code } } } } }

tools.name: wave_list_customers
tools.description: List the customers of a business, newest first, optionally filtered by email address. Page-based: see pageInfo.totalPages.

email.description: Only customers with this email address.

endpointMapping.path: query ListCustomers($businessId: ID!, $email: String, $page: Int = 1, $pageSize: Int = 45) { business(id: $businessId) { customers(email: $email, page: $page, pageSize: $pageSize) { pageInfo { currentPage totalPages totalCount } edges { node { id name email firstName lastName currency { code } } } } } }

tools.name: wave_create_customer
tools.description: Create a customer in a business. Returns the customer, or didSucceed false with inputErrors explaining why Wave refused it.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. USD or CAD.

endpointMapping.path: mutation CreateCustomer($businessId: ID!, $name: String!, $email: String, $currency: CurrencyCode) { customerCreate(input: { businessId: $businessId, name: $name, email: $email, currency: $currency }) { didSucceed inputErrors { path message code } customer { id name email currency { code } } } }

tools.name: wave_list_invoices
tools.description: List the invoices of a business, newest first. Filter by status (DRAFT, UNSENT, SAVED, SENT, VIEWED, PARTIAL, OVERDUE, PAID, OVERPAID) and/or customer. Page-based: see pageInfo.totalPages.

status.description: Invoice status: DRAFT, UNSENT, SAVED, SENT, VIEWED, PARTIAL, OVERDUE, PAID or OVERPAID.

customer_id.description: Only invoices of this customer (ID from wave_list_customers).

endpointMapping.path: query ListInvoices($businessId: ID!, $status: InvoiceStatus, $customerId: ID, $page: Int = 1, $pageSize: Int = 45) { business(id: $businessId) { invoices(status: $status, customerId: $customerId, page: $page, pageSize: $pageSize) { pageInfo { currentPage totalPages totalCount } edges { node { id invoiceNumber status customer { id name } invoiceDate dueDate total { value currency { code } } amountDue { value } } } } } }

tools.name: wave_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice of a business with its line items, totals, memo and links to view it or download the PDF.

endpointMapping.path: query GetInvoice($businessId: ID!, $invoiceId: ID!) { business(id: $businessId) { invoice(id: $invoiceId) { id invoiceNumber status title customer { id name email } invoiceDate dueDate items { product { id name } description quantity unitPrice subtotal { value } total { value } } subtotal { value } taxTotal { value } total { value currency { code } } amountDue { value } amountPaid { value } memo footer viewUrl pdfUrl lastSentAt } } }

tools.name: wave_list_products
tools.description: List the products and services of a business (name, description, unit price, whether sold and/or bought). Page-based: see pageInfo.totalPages.

endpointMapping.path: query ListProducts($businessId: ID!, $page: Int = 1, $pageSize: Int = 45) { business(id: $businessId) { products(page: $page, pageSize: $pageSize) { pageInfo { currentPage totalPages totalCount } edges { node { id name description unitPrice isSold isBought isArchived } } } } }

tools.name: wave_list_accounts
tools.description: List the chart of accounts (ledger accounts) of a business: id, name, type, subtype and currency. Returns up to 200 active accounts.

endpointMapping.path: query ListAccounts($businessId: ID!) { business(id: $businessId) { accounts(page: 1, pageSize: 200) { pageInfo { currentPage totalPages totalCount } edges { node { id name type { value name } subtype { value name } currency { code } } } } } }

tools.name: wave_send_invoice
tools.description: Email an invoice to one or more addresses through Wave. Returns didSucceed, or inputErrors explaining why Wave refused it.

attach_pdf.description: Attach the invoice as a PDF (default false).

endpointMapping.path: mutation SendInvoice($invoiceId: ID!, $to: [String!]!, $subject: String, $message: String, $attachPDF: Boolean = false) { invoiceSend(input: { invoiceId: $invoiceId, to: $to, subject: $subject, message: $message, attachPDF: $attachPDF }) { didSucceed inputErrors { path message code } } }
